about: Beauty shots of the amphitheatre (unreal/shoot_board.py with REDROCKS_VIEWS pointing here). Level frame: X east, Y south, cm; yaw clockwise from +X seen from above. Golden hour: evening sun behind the top rows (WSW, 7 deg) for the views looking east; morning sun over the plains (E, 9 deg) for the views looking west. Night: sun under the horizon, moon, and the show rig of unreal/night_show.py.

views.name: top_rows_wide
views.what: From the top walkway over the centre aisle: the 70 rows down to the stage, Creation Rock left, Ship Rock right, the plains out to Denver

views.name: stage_up_bowl
views.what: From the stage deck: the rows climbing the bowl between the monoliths

views.name: ship_rock
views.what: Ship Rock's face over the south aisle, from the middle rows

views.name: night_show
views.what: A show from the upper rows: the stage rig, beams in the haze, the rocks washed in colour
